text:
maya: quick check — i'm about to open a tiny terraform change that switches redis-consumer's config from a k8s Secret to an ExternalSecret (vault kv v2). worried about the configmap-binding sidecar we use to inject templates. will the current binding annotation still pick up the secret once externalsecret syncs it? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432

maya: current annotation in pod template looks like:
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    app.example.com/config-secret: "redis-consumer-config"
    app.example.com/reload-on-secret-change: "true"
```

aj: should be fine as long as ExternalSecrets creates a real k8s Secret with the same name/keys. external-secrets writes a Secret object, so the binding will see it. main thing: keys must match exactly.

sam: fyi rotation behaviour — when ExternalSecret sync updates the Secret, does that update trigger our rollout logic? our restart controller watches the Secret resourceVersion + checksum annotation, right?

yuki: correct, the rollout controller we run watches `metadata.resourceVersion` changes on the Secret and also checksum annotations in the Deployment. but watch out: some ExternalSecrets implementations replace the Secret (delete+create) which can flip resourceVersion unpredictably — controller handles that but the checksum approach is more robust.

maya: hmm ok. aj, in the TF i'm using `external-secrets.kubernetes.com/refresh: "1m"` as an annotation on the ExternalSecret to force faster sync. any concerns?

aj: that's fine in staging. in prod i'd avoid <5m unless you need it — extra pod churn if it flips frequently. also make sure role bound to ExternalSecrets has `secrets: get,watch,list,update` perms.

sam: can we add a small change to Deployment to compute checksum from the Secret so the rollout is explicit? e.g. add to pod template annotations: `checksum/redis-config: "{{ index .Secrets \"redis-consumer-config\" .data | sha256 }}"` (psuedo).

maya: happy to add that. will include a short note in PR and add a test that simulates an ExternalSecret update and verifies the Deployment gets a new checksum annotation.

deploy-bot: infra/pr-432 has passed unit checks, integration job queued (staging). :white_check_mark:

yuki: also add a note in the runbook: if ExternalSecret provider flips Secret objects, follow the debugging steps (check ExternalSecret status, controller logs, and the Secret's ownerReferences). small checklist helps oncall.

maya: thx — i'll update PR with checksum annotation, perms note, and runbook blurb. pinging @aj and @yuki for review when i push the change. :thumbsup:
